query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Find recent remote or hybrid contract data-engineering-related job listings in a target region, validate/extract job details from job boards, compile a curated digest, and email it to someone.
query_ground_truth.query: parse and retrieve the specific role requirements from the active web page
query_ground_truth.rationale: Automates browser navigation and data extraction to pull full listing details.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Identify one or more candidate listing URLs (optionally discovered elsewhere) and prepare to compare against the claimed source.
[Required] [Step]: Fetch page text using COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT (capture extracted text plus any per-URL status metadata).

[Required] [Next Step]: Validate content using COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT statuses and extracted text (confirm it reads like an active listing with responsibilities/requirements and an apply path; flag redirects/hub pages/closures).

[Optional (if page is a hub/duplicate/closed or canonical URL is unclear)] [Next Step]: Discover a more authoritative posting URL using COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB, then re-run COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT and re-validate.

[Optional (if key sections seem missing due to truncation)] [Fallback]: Re-fetch the same URL using COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT with a larger max_characters and re-check for the missing sections.
known_pitfalls: [COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT] Response separates statuses and results; verify statuses before trusting extracted text.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT] Extracted text may be truncated if max_characters is too low; absence of sections can be a truncation artifact.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT] Summary output may be empty even when extracted text exists; rely on the text field for validation.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT.description: Fetch and extract clean, readable page text (markdown) from public web pages (HTML content) using the Exa API. Use when you need to retrieve actual content from search results or documentation links to extract setup steps, requirements, or citations. Only works with web page URLs - does not support direct links to images, PDFs, or other binary files.

text.description: Include extracted markdown text content from the page. Defaults to true.

urls.description: List of public URLs to web pages (HTML content) to fetch content from. URLs must be valid and publicly accessible. Do not use direct links to images (.jpg, .png, .gif), PDFs, or other binary files - use web page URLs only. Also accepts a single URL string.

extras.description: Additional content options like imageLinks or links counts (e.g., {'imageLinks': 3, 'links': 5}).

summary.description: Include AI-generated summary of the page content. Can be boolean or object with query/schema options.

max_characters.description: Maximum number of characters to extract from each page. Maps to text.maxCharacters in Exa API.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB.description: Perform a web search using the Exa API. Returns a nested structure: narrative summary under results.answer, sources under results.citations (and optionally results.organic_results). Prioritize results.citations as primary evidence over results.answer, which can be vague. Only indexes publicly available content — no paywalled, login-gated, or private content. No date filters enforced; include recency terms in query and verify dates in snippets manually. Throttle to ~1–2 requests/second; bursty queries trigger HTTP 429. Large responses may be stored remotely — use structure_info to locate results.answer and results.citations.

query.description: The search query for the Composio Exa API. Must be non-empty; using any other parameter name (e.g., 'q') causes an invalid-request error. Include qualifiers (year, region, platform, intent) for better results — broad queries return generic content; excessive site: or quoted-term filters can return zero results. Add disambiguating terms (city, role, domain) when searching for people or organizations with common names.

FIRECRAWL_SCRAPE.description: Scrapes a publicly accessible URL, optionally performing pre-scrape browser actions or extracting structured JSON using an LLM, to retrieve content in specified formats.

url.description: The fully qualified URL of the web page to scrape. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://' and be a valid web URL.

key.description: Key to press (e.g., 'Enter', 'Escape', 'Tab'), used with 'press' actions.

text.description: Text to be typed into an element, used with 'write' actions.

type.description: The type of browser action to perform on the page before scraping. Supported actions: 'wait', 'click', 'screenshot', 'write', 'press', 'scroll'.

selector.description: CSS selector for the HTML element targeted by the action. Required for actions like 'click' or 'write'.

milliseconds.description: Specifies a duration in milliseconds, e.g., for a 'wait' action or a delay.

items.description: Action to perform on the page

actions.description: An optional list of browser actions (e.g., click, write, wait, press) to perform on the page before scraping. Useful for interacting with dynamic content, filling forms, or navigating through page elements.

formats.description: A list of desired output formats for the scraped content. Defaults to ['markdown']. Cannot include both 'screenshot' and 'screenshot@fullPage'. If 'json' is included, jsonOptions must be provided.

timeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the scraping request to complete. Defaults to 30000.

waitFor.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for the page to load or for dynamic content to render before starting the scrape. Defaults to 0.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to make the request from (e.g., 'US', 'AU', 'DE', 'JP').

languages.description: List of preferred languages and locales for the request, in order of priority. Uses format like 'en-US'.

excludeTags.description: A list of HTML tags to specifically exclude from the output. Content within these tags will be removed.

includeTags.description: A list of HTML tags to specifically include in the output. Content within these tags will be prioritized.

examples: Extract the main headline and the first paragraph.
What are the product specifications mentioned on this page?
Summarize the article in three bullet points.
prompt.description: A user-defined prompt for data extraction when a specific JSON schema is not provided. Guides the LLM on what information to extract.

schema.description: A JSON Schema object defining the structure for data extraction. The LLM will populate this schema with data from the page. The API requires 'type': 'object' at the root level. Supported formats: (1) Object schema with properties - used as-is. (2) Array schema with items - automatically wrapped as {type: object, properties: {items: <your_array_schema>}}; the extracted data will be returned under the 'items' key. (3) Simplified property definitions - automatically wrapped with type: object.

examples: Focus on product details and specifications.
systemPrompt.description: A system-level prompt to guide the LLM during JSON extraction, setting context or desired behavior. Note: This parameter is only supported in v1 API; it is ignored when using v2 API.

onlyMainContent.description: If true, attempts to extract only the main article content, excluding headers, footers, navigation bars, and ads. Defaults to true.
